title: The Long Archive
author: Zephyrine Eriksen
blurb: Isandro Crane, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the jump window closes.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
